front.title: POC for Windows Application Configuration Files

abstract.t: This POC targets Windows application configuration files including web servers, database management tools, and system installation files that may contain sensitive information and credentials.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: This proof of concept demonstrates reading Windows application configuration files commonly found on web servers and development environments.

section.name: Target Applications
section.t: The following application configuration files are targeted:

ul.li: Windows Unattend.xml - may contain administrator passwords
